what: Reinsurance Group of America reinsures life and health insurance. Primary insurers pass it a share of their mortality, longevity and health risk, and it also provides capital solutions to insurers through structured transactions.
customers: Life and health insurers worldwide, plus pension schemes transferring longevity risk.
money: traditional life reinsurance and financial solutions
life and health reinsurance across Asia and Europe
moat: Mortality and morbidity data across decades and dozens of markets, which lets it price life risk more accurately than the insurers ceding it.
risks: Unexpected mortality events, as in the pandemic, produce large losses
Net margin of about 5% reflects a reinsurance business with large premium volumes
Interest rate moves change the value of long-dated liabilities
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year and about 13% a year over three years
Asian life insurance growth drives structural demand for reinsurance
Pension longevity transfers are a growing market with few capable counterparties
watch: Value of new business written and mortality experience against assumptions.
